prompt: The first-person perspective begins with a steady forward movement along a snow-covered trail in the Mardi Himal region of Kaski, Nepal, under a night sky. The camera advances slowly, capturing the texture of the snow-laden ground and the occasional dark patches of exposed earth. As the viewer progresses, the surrounding environment reveals sparse, leafless trees that stand tall against the dimly lit backdrop, their branches reaching out into the darkness. The camera angle remains at eye level, providing an immersive experience of navigating through the snowy terrain. The ambient light is minimal, casting long shadows and creating a serene yet eerie atmosphere. Snowflakes gently fall from above, adding a dynamic element to the otherwise still scene. The path curves slightly, leading the viewer past a metal railing on the left side, which guides the way along the edge of a steep slope. The camera continues its steady advance, occasionally panning slightly to the right to reveal more of the rugged landscape, emphasizing the isolation and quietude of the nighttime setting. The overall color palette is dominated by shades of blue and gray, enhancing the cold and wintry ambiance. The scene remains empty of any human presence, reinforcing the sense of solitude amidst nature's vastness.
